title: Shiwu Yu: Hesui Donghua PV

alternative_titles.en: The Tale of Food - Chinese New Year PV

synopsis:
It’s time to celebrate the Lunar New Year! Happy New Year, Young Master!

Savoring tea in spring, wandering by the sea in summer, admiring the moon in autumn, and reuniting in winter—having journeyed through the seasons together, the Young Master and the Food Souls are once again welcoming a lively New Year at Kongsang. We are deeply grateful for your constant companionship and support! In the year ahead, the Food Souls look forward to embarking on even more culinary adventures by your side! (≧∇≦)ﾉ

As we bid farewell to the old year and welcome the new, let us shout out loud:
"Wishing you great fortune in the Year of the Ox!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
